question: Should OpenClaw accept first-party Control UI math rendering through this MathJax approach, and what syntax/dependency provenance is required before merge?
rationale: The feature has user value, but it changes global rendering of untrusted chat output and adds same-origin third-party JavaScript, so automation should not choose the permanent syntax or vendor/dependency boundary alone.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Replace the opaque bundle with reviewed package/build provenance and remove `$...$` parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that compatibility change.

options.title: Accept owner-approved vendoring
options.body: Maintainers may accept the bundled MathJax asset only with documented source, version, license, update, and review provenance.

options.title: Defer this implementation
options.body: Pause this PR and converge on the canonical feature request with a different KaTeX/MathJax design if core math rendering is not ready to sponsor.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Replace the opaque bundle with reviewed package/build provenance and remove `$...$` parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that compatibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the Control UI/Gateway serving, CSP, dependency, and product-decision surfaces most affected by this PR.
